objective: Implement incidents, notes, drafts, publish transaction, postmortem and provider routes with API integration tests.
context: Built to spec 3.4-3.7, 3.9, 6, 9, 11.2. Services in src/services own all SQL for these routes; routes validate with contract-schemas. Publish and every draft mutation run in db.tx (BEGIN IMMEDIATE, synchronous) and re-run the verifier, ignoring stored status. Provider calls run outside transactions with a deadline (config.generateTimeoutMs, default 150000) and in-memory per-incident lock. Provider registry: injected providers win; when createApp receives providers={} the registry builds anthropic, cli, fallback (and fake/fake-clean only with GW_ENABLE_FAKE=1) from config, so real providers are wired without editing src/index.js (not in my owned files). Injected test providers must use an id from PROVIDER_IDS (tests use 'fake').
expectedOutput: Working domain API with passing integration tests for journey, contract, RBAC, IDOR, notes, draft, publish, audit, validation, errors, persistence and perf.
acceptanceCriteria: Journey sign in -> incident -> notes -> draft -> UNGROUNDED_STATEMENTS -> fix -> publish -> viewer reads (journey.test.js)
Publish in BEGIN IMMEDIATE with re-verify; tampered statuses and 50 interleaved edit/publish rounds never publish flagged statements (publish.test.js)
Provider timeout, malformed output, outage, busy return documented codes and store nothing (draft.test.js)
IDOR matrix returns 404 with data unchanged; viewers read only own-team published postmortems; only leads publish (idor, rbac, journey)
Data survives in-process reopen and spawned-process restart (persistence.test.js)
Fallback draft isFallback true in API (draft.test.js)
completedWork: Added src/services/{index,providers,incidents,drafts}.js; routes incidents, notes, drafts, postmortems, providers; 12 API test files. Full test/api suite: 83 pass, 0 fail, 1 skipped (pre-existing, not mine). Unit suite: 111 pass.
remainingIssues: src/index.js still calls createApp without providers; real providers are built by the registry fallback in src/services/providers.js, so no index.js change is required, but the owner of index.js may prefer explicit wiring.
Spec 3.6 says the 160 s per-request socket timeout is applied via rc.extendTimeout; verified only by code path, not by a test with a long-running provider.
Non-ProviderError exceptions from a provider map to 502 PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE (logged by class only); spec was silent.
Claimed audit-on-deny only covers actions in AUDIT_ON_DENY (publish, users, audit); other 403s are not audited.
nextAction: qa-engineer: review coverage against spec 11.2 and run the browser journey against these routes.
